description: Two multiples in one panel, each summing two inputs and copying the result to eight jacks

notes: the two halves are wholly separate; nothing crosses between A and B.
with one input patched and the other empty the half is a plain one-to-eight multiple, since an unpatched jack reads 0V.
the sum is not scaled, so two signals into one half come out at their combined level.
